feeding_claim.verbatim: In addition to the grasses and legumes that the cattle graze, we also feed grains, vegetables, and unique byproducts such as apple pulp, cherry juice, and spent grain from Michigan breweries.

notes: Scout 2026-11-28: read the michigancraftbeef.com homepage, About, FAQs and Products pages through WebFetch summaries; the quote was assembled from summary fragments, so Verifier: recheck exact wording.
